name: Split Barrage
text: Skirmish twice in a turn with weapons on different mounts, and move in between, instead of firing both together as a Barrage.

name: Brace only on big hits
text: Brace is only offered when a hit would take you to 0 HP, overheat you, or deal more than half your HP.

name: Repeat a Quick Tech option
text: The same Quick Tech option (say, Invade) may be used twice in a turn.

name: Flying at a fixed height
text: Flying puts you 3 spaces above the surface below you instead of choosing your height freely.

name: Aux-only fire counts as the mount
text: Firing just the Auxiliary weapon of a mount that also has a Main weapon counts as firing the mount, so the Aux attack deals no bonus damage.

name: Building collapse roll
text: When a hit deals 5 or more damage to a wall or building section and it's still standing, it rolls 1d6 + its Armor: on 3 or less it collapses anyway.

name: Brace for the fall
text: A character about to take fall damage may use its reaction to brace and take half.

name: No Stun from a Direct Hit
text: A Direct Hit's Stun becomes Brace's penalties instead: no reactions and only one quick action until the end of your next turn (so nobody sits out a whole round).

name: Hide behind hard cover
text: Hard cover from every hostile that can see you is enough to Hide, and to stay Hidden.

name: Recharge costs NPC heat
text: NPCs with a Heat Cap take 1 heat when they use a Recharge 4+ or 5+ ability, 2 heat for Recharge 6+.

name: Overheated
text: A mech made Exposed by overheating is also Overheated: no Heat (Self) weapons or systems and no Overkill until it Stabilizes to cool down.

name: Origin perks
text: Small combat perks from your pilot's origin. Former employer: +1 Accuracy on your first attack each scene against a frame from that manufacturer (you know their weak spots).

name: Garrisoned buildings
text: Units can go inside buildings through their doors. Inside, one space holds one unit of Size 1 or more on its own, or up to two Size 1/2 units (pilots, single soldiers, half-size mechs) plus one squad. If the building comes down, everyone inside takes damage as if they fell its height (3 armor-piercing kinetic per 3 spaces, up to 9, the book's falling numbers) and is moved to the nearest free space. (The book's own rules always decide cover: a unit at a window has hard cover and can shoot out through it, Core p.66.)

name: Reinforcements can bring a soldier squad
text: The Reinforcements reserve (by the book: one friendly NPC mech, once per mission, Core p.52) may bring one of the squad's own soldier squads instead.
